body:
Fixing two CWD/home-directory issues surfaced by user Q&A:
1. sysinfo tool's "environment" section reports the server process's
   os.getcwd() instead of the session-tracked cwd (can diverge/go stale).
2. git_tool and process_tool's session-cwd ContextVars are declared but
   never populated by agent_runtime (only shell's is wired), so git/process
   commands silently run from the server cwd instead of the session's.
3. Home directory is never normalized to `~` for display -- the system
   prompt and sysinfo show the raw OS-literal path (e.g. C:\Users\tison on
   Windows) instead of a cross-platform `~`-relative form. Adding a
   home-relative display helper in context_builder.py. Tools already
   support `~` via Path.expanduser(), so this is display-only, no behavior
   change to path resolution.
Narrow, additive fix -- no overlap expected with Tariq's B-2026-09-15-15
(memory_intent.py / _memory_mixin.py / agent_runtime.py chat-history paths
/ frontend hook+components), except agent_runtime.py which I'm touching at
a different, unrelated call site (the cwd-sync block, not memory/chat
logic) -- flagging via a note as well.
